newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 28.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Abdou Diouf of Senegal is to make an official visit to Ivory Coast from August 11-14.
- A new fishing port is to be officially opened in San Pedro in southwest Ivory Coast on Tuesday. Japanese aid money funded the facility, which cost seven billion CFA francs ($11 million).
- Ivory Coast overwhelmed Mali 4-2 at home on Sunday to qualify for the finals of the African Nations Cup next year in Burkina Faso.
